summary: Remote public API and cross-tenant controllers use separate PostgreSQL roles; controller scans require the dedicated non-BYPASSRLS role.
invariants: Remote API login is not superuser, BYPASSRLS, or a controller-role member
Cross-tenant queue controllers require membership in presenton_public_controller
Request access remains owner-and-tenant RLS scoped
forbidden: Sharing one production DB authority between public API and controllers
Treating an unscoped request connection as controller authority
